question: What causal claim allows the speaker to assert knowledge of the Kaula determination in the presence of the Lord of the Kaulas?
premises: The speaker addresses the Lord of the Kaulas.
Knowledge of the Kaula determination is at stake.
That knowledge is obtained by the grace of the Lord of the Kaulas.
inference: By the grace of the Lord of the Kaulas, the speaker has come to know the Kaula determination.
uncertainties: Degree or mode of that grace not specified
plain_english: By your grace, O Lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the Kaula determination.
